content.title: What’s open and closed in Mass. on Patriots’ Day, Marathon Monday 2026
content.text: By Chris McLaughlin | cmclaughlin@masslive.comPatriots’ Day — a statewide holiday in Massachusetts — falls on April 20 this year, but while many businesses and services will run as usual, others at a state level will be closed or affected.Patriots’ Day is observed on the third Monday in April, and commemorates the start of the American Revolution.The Boston Athletic Association (BAA) also hosts the annual Boston Marathon on this date, in which tens of thousands of participants make their way from Hopkinton to the finish line on Boylston Street in Boston, cheered on by throngs of spectators up and down the 26.2-mile race route. This year marks the 130th running of the marathon.Since Patriots’ Day is a Massachusetts-specific holiday, most businesses and federal government services and offices are largely unaffected. However, services pertaining to Massachusetts state government will be closed.School will be out of session for public school students statewide due to April vacation week from April 20-24.Here’s what’s open and closed on Patriots’ Day 2026.GovernmentFederal Courts: OpenState Courts: ClosedFederal Offices: OpenState Offices: ClosedMunicipal Offices: ClosedRegistry of Motor Vehicles (RMV): ClosedPublic Libraries: ClosedPublic Schools: ClosedFinanceThe New York Stock Exchange and the Dow Jones: OpenBanks: Most banks should be open, but check with your local bank.Alcohol & CannabisLiquor Stores: OpenCannabis Dispensaries: Massachusetts regulators don’t identify specific holidays for when cannabis dispensaries must close, according to the Cannabis Control Commission. It’s up to respective dispensaries to choose whether or not to be open or closed, so check with your local dispensary.ShoppingRetail Stores: Most retail locations will be open, but check with your local retailer if you have concerns.Aldi: OpenAuburn Mall: OpenBig Y: OpenCostco: OpenCVS: OpenHampshire Mall: OpenHolyoke Mall: OpenMarket Basket: OpenNatick Mall: Open, but the Boston Marathon route may interfere with travel.Price Rite: OpenSafeway: OpenStar Market: OpenStop & Shop: OpenTarget: OpenTrader Joe’s: OpenWalgreens: OpenWalmart: OpenWegmans: OpenWhole Foods: OpenParcelU.S. Post Offices (USPS): OpenFedEx: OpenUPS: OpenTransportationBerkshire Regional Transit Authority: Regular bus serviceBrockton Area Transit: Regular bus serviceCape Ann Transportation Authority: Buses will operate on a Saturday-level service. The Beverly Shuttle and Beverly Commuter Bus will operate normally.Cape Cod Regional Transit Authority: Saturday scheduleFranklin Regional Transit Authority: Regular bus serviceLowell Regional Transit Authority: Saturday scheduleMassachusetts Bay Transportation Authority (MBTA): Subway, ferry and The Ride services will operate on a weekday schedule. Buses will run on a modified Saturday schedule to accommodate the marathon. There will be a special marathon schedule on the Worcester commuter rail line with additional inbound and outbound trains, but all other lines will operate on weekday schedule. For a comprehensive guide to the MBTA’s Marathon Monday schedule, service changes and restrictions, see here.Merrimack Valley Transit: Saturday scheduleMetroWest Regional Transit Authority: No serviceMontachusett Regional Transit Authority: ClosedPioneer Valley Transit Authority: A mix of service availability, see here for more details.Southeastern Regional Transit Authority: Weekend serviceWorcester Regional Transit Authority: Saturday servicePrivateFlixBus/Greyhound: Greyhound and FlixBus monitor demand closely and make adjustments as needed, including increasing service during peak travel periods like holidays and long weekends, a company spokesperson told MassLive.There are no set changes to bus route service for specific holidays, but keep track of your individual booking through FlixBus and Greyhound’s websites.Peter Pan Bus Lines: Peter Pan Bus Lines operates its bus routes every day of the year, including all holidays, for the 120 communities it serves in the Northeast, a company spokesperson told MassLive.Boston Marathon Bingo: The predictable things you see along the routeNASA legend and Mass. native Sunita Williams completes Boston MarathonHoots, hollers and ‘last hurrahs’ fill the air at Wellesley College ‘Scream Tunnel’Bill and Hillary Clinton greet daughter Chelsea at finish line of Boston Marathon Zdeno Chara completes another Boston Marathon in under 4 hoursChris McLaughlin is a social media producer for MassLive.
